page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent processing capabilities.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

The lack of local storage and GPU hardware limits the instance's suitability for workloads requiring high-speed local disk I/O or hardware-accelerated graphics and machine learning processing. However, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make it appropriate for enterprise applications, web serving, and general-purpose workloads that require consistent CPU performance without resource contention.
